claim_under_test: a CONFLICT raised by a partial apply cannot be settled by either resolution class the engine advertises
why_this_run_exists: the ticket was filed from ONE live incident in the real project (2026-10-02T05:49Z). A single sample cannot distinguish a deterministic defect from a one-off. This drives the same path on purpose, with a negative control, in a scratch project.

harness.how_the_failure_is_forced: the harness opens .saipen/STATE.md with `open(path, 'r+b')` and holds it. Win32 opens without FILE_SHARE_DELETE, so os.replace on that target fails with WinError 5 -- the same failure an antivirus scanner, a search indexer or a second writer produces, with no timing race involved.

the_sharper_root_cause_the_original_tick.what_actually_happens: resolve() runs _run_verifier BEFORE settling, and the half-applied operation is exactly what that verifier rejects -- 'STATE proposed last_event 3 != LOG tail 4'.
